_readme: Change models here. 'default_model' is used when --model is not given. benchmark.py reads the 'benchmark' block. Any model ID works; the provider is chosen by prefix (gemini* -> Google Vertex, gpt-/o1/o3/o4/chatgpt- -> OpenAI, everything else -> Anthropic).

pricing_usd_per_mtok._source: Anthropic: Claude API model table (cached 2026-09-25). Gemini: third-party aggregators, not yet confirmed on Google's pricing page. Models not listed show cost as n/a.
